title: Nvidia's $20B Investment in OpenAI: Game-Changer? — 2026-02-05
description: In a groundbreaking move, Nvidia is reportedly investing $20 billion in OpenAI, marking a significant shift in the AI landscape. This investment could propel advancements in AI technology and reshape the industry's future. Meanwhile, Nvidia's rival, Cerebras, has raised $1 billion, valuing the company at $23 billion, highlighting the fierce competition in the AI sector. Additionally, ElevenLabs, an Nvidia-backed AI voice startup, has reached an $11 billion valuation as it eyes an IPO. These developments underscore the rapid growth and investment in AI technologies.
